# Security and privacy reports

Do not open a public issue containing credentials, private contact information, or unpublished project documents.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for security problems when it is available for this repository. For ordinary broken links or rendering defects, use the public issue templates after removing private information from screenshots and logs.

This is a static Jekyll site. The primary risks are accidental publication of private files, unsafe third-party dependencies, and links or scripts that expose visitor data.
